# HTTP API

A running instance serves the interactive Swagger UI at `/docs` and ReDoc at `/redoc`.

| Method | Path | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/api/config` | Active configuration |
| `GET` | `/api/health` | Liveness check |
| `GET` | `/api/version` | Installed jogpad version |
